summary: Nvni Group Limited, a Cayman-incorporated Brazilian software issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing that on October 7, 2026 Nasdaq's Hearings Panel denied its request to remain listed, suspending trading at the open on October 9, 2026. The delisting stems from failure to regain compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(2), requiring market value of primary listed securities above $35 million; a July 28, 2026 delisting determination had been stayed pending the September 3 hearing. The Company may seek Listing and Hearing Review Council review within 15 days, or the Council may act within 45 days. Watch any review request and OTC transition liquidity.
